calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cs.format, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
), ret AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT format,
  (s.store_id=999) is999, (s.category='ZZ Test') test,
  count(*) lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.qty > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > s.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_amt,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(r.sales_line_id) returned, sum(r.refund_net) refunds
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id)

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cs.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), ret AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Small' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
